summary: Wheeler Real Estate Investment Trust filed an 8-K reporting a privately negotiated exchange with affiliates of director Joseph Stilwell: on September 30, 2026 it issued 161,700 common shares for 30,800 Series B and 7,700 Series D preferred shares, a 21-for-4 ratio, with the preferred retired and cancelled and no cash proceeds. The exchange relied on Section 3(a)(9); no advisors or board recommendation disclosed. Related Item 3.03 notes a conversion-price modification for the 7.00% Subordinated Convertible Notes due 2031 tied to Series D redemptions. Watch dilution, preferred overhang reduction, and insider alignment.
